authorization: User requested review of whole series story flow,preview images and navigation on mobile and desktop,and fixes for pending issues.
scope: Fourteen online pages,existing reading sequence and book sections;no PDF rebuild.

findings.issue: Repeated opening/closing previews within the book break forward flow; introductory/endmatter sections need clearer continuation links.
Kuvi introduction mentions companion article without an explicit link.
Locator labels shrink too small at narrow viewport widths despite no page overflow.
Market and public-dance preview photos need a short contextual note to avoid implied identity with named people in the descriptions.
Rendered chapters contain separate authored image-credit and generated note headings both called Footnotes and Sources; consolidate into one visible source section while keeping note IDs/backlinks.

verification.independent_review: Drishti passed exact reviewed head; Anvesha reviewed narrative flow.
verification.limitations: Chrome emulated viewport and touch checks; no physical-device, screen-reader or new community validation. PDFs unchanged.
